_README: SITE IMAGES — global images shared across every page. Currently
just the header logo. Page-specific photos (hero shots, portraits,
gallery images) live inside each page's own file in
a page's photos happens in the same place as its text.
HOW TO UPDATE: change 'src' to a new path under public/images/
(upload the file there first), update 'alt' to describe the new
image, save, commit, push. Editable via the CMS at /admin too.
